evals.prompt: 做一个可交互的 3D 展示页：虚构的深海热液采矿车 ABYSSAL CRAWLER AC-7——四条履带、前端旋转切削滚筒、背部吸料管和两条机械臂，在海底热液区作业。要工业概念设计图那种风格，单个 HTML 文件，1080p 60fps 就行，不需要自动演示模式。我没有参考图。
evals.expected_output: Single HTML Three.js page: warm paper background, procedural crawler, bilingual technical-plate HUD (spec table, schematic card, three bottom panels, two-column leader labels, perf readout), eased camera presets, X-ray/cutaway/exploded/reference style modes, synced keys and buttons, no console errors, screenshots.
assertions: Delivers exactly one HTML page in the output root
No TODO / FIXME / placeholder text in source
Loads with no console errors or page errors
Background is a warm light paper tone (not dark / not neon)
HUD is bilingual (>=30 CJK chars alongside English labels)
Three bottom engineering panels side by side
Performance readout shows FPS and draw calls
Draw calls per frame within budget (median <= 150)
Number keys switch between >=4 distinct camera presets
Active button state follows keyboard preset changes
X key toggles an X-ray style view
E key toggles an exploded view
